extracted.name: Bacon-Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers
extracted.description: These jalapeño poppers are filled with a blend of cream cheese and Cheddar cheese in this easy to make, crowd-pleasing, bacon-wrapped appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 12 jalapeno peppers, halved lengthwise, seeds and membranes removed
instruction_lines: Gather ingredients. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Mix cream cheese and Cheddar cheese together in a bowl until evenly blended. Fill each jalapeño half with cheese mixture.
Put halves back together and wrap each stuffed pepper with a slice of bacon. Arrange bacon-wrapped jalapeño peppers on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until bacon is crispy, 25 to 35 minutes.
Serve poppers hot with your favorite dipping sauce. Enjoy!
